scope: I6.5 B3-004/B3-005 + I6.6 Cobros/Conciliación + I6.7 commission timing linkage

supersedes.scope: Separates migrated SIGA/CRM direct-payment evidence from future client-portal reports; forbids one-by-one manual application/reconciliation of deterministic legacy batches; preserves all non-conflicting V2 rules.

invariants: Migrated SIGA/CRM payment records are not client-reported portal payments.
Current tenant portal payment intake is not operational; no current migrated payment may be labeled as client-reported solely because estadoOperativo is pago_reportado.
A SIGA/CRM cobros_realizados record with sufficient unique receipt identity is direct evidence of an already-effected payment and must not require one-by-one Apply Payment action.

Direct migrated CRM payments materialize idempotently as PAID_DIRECT while preserving source date/method/provenance; they remain pending reconciliation/application evidence when those states are not yet proven.

High-confidence reconciliation against bank statements, insurer statements, commission statements, invoices or equivalent evidence auto-commits/enriches the same payment; it does not require row-by-row human clicks.
Expected receipt is an obligation, never proof of payment by itself.
Client-reported payment is valid payment evidence and is sufficient to materialize the payment state without requiring an attachment.
Payment support and insurer invoice are optional evidence enrichments and must remain distinct.
High-confidence unique-match inference is applied automatically; it does not wait for human approval.
Ambiguous, contradictory, partial, renumbered or non-contiguous cases remain fail-closed and require review.
No retry, later evidence, invoice or statement may create a second cobro for the same policy/installment reality.
Actual payment date, inferred period date, evidence as-of date, application date and reconciliation timestamp are distinct fields and may not overwrite each other.

evidenceRules.evidence: SIGA CRM / cobros_realizados or equivalent frozen migration source containing an actual recorded payment linked uniquely to policy/receipt.
evidenceRules.directEffect: Materialize the unique matched payment as PAID_DIRECT without manual Apply Payment. Preserve paidDate/paymentMethod when present and source provenance.
evidenceRules.inferredEffect: No additional installments are inferred solely from the CRM payment row; prior-installment inference requires another approved rule/evidence.
evidenceRules.reconciliationEffect: Payment remains pending reconciliation until bank/insurer/commission/application evidence resolves it; high-confidence matches auto-reconcile/enrich the same payment idempotently.
evidenceRules.uiRule: Show Pago registrado en SIGA / pendiente de conciliación, never Reportado por cliente and never a one-by-one Aplicar pago button.

evidenceRules.evidence: Factura/recibo de aseguradora que identifica el pago/cuota N de una póliza
evidenceRules.directEffect: Cuota N queda confirmada y conciliada con esa evidencia.
evidenceRules.inferredEffect: Cuotas anteriores contiguas 1..N-1 se consideran pagadas/conciliadas por inferencia si continúan abiertas y no existe evidencia contradictoria.
evidenceRules.example: Factura del pago 5 -> pago 5 directo; pagos 1,2,3,4 se cierran por inferencia si estaban pendientes.

evidenceRules.evidence: Estado de cuenta de aseguradora indica que la póliza presenta pagos pendientes a partir de la cuota N
evidenceRules.directEffect: La evidencia prueba que N y posteriores señalados continúan pendientes según el estado.
evidenceRules.inferredEffect: Cuotas anteriores 1..N-1 se consideran pagadas/conciliadas por inferencia si no hay contradicción.
evidenceRules.example: Pendientes desde pago 3 -> pagos 1 y 2 se consideran pagados; 3 en adelante permanecen pendientes salvo otra evidencia.

evidenceRules.evidence: Planilla/estado de comisiones paga comisión correspondiente a la cuota N de una póliza/cliente
evidenceRules.directEffect: La cuota N se considera recaudada/pagada y puede materializar/reconciliar su cobro.
evidenceRules.inferredEffect: Cuotas anteriores contiguas 1..N-1 se consideran ya pagadas/conciliadas si seguían abiertas y no hay contradicción.
evidenceRules.example: Comisión pagada por cuota 4 -> cuota 4 directa; cuotas 1,2,3 por inferencia.

evidenceRules.evidence: Estado de cuenta bancario contiene pago identificable a cliente/póliza/recibo
evidenceRules.directEffect: Se materializa/reconcilia el cobro correspondiente al match.
evidenceRules.inferredEffect: Solo se backfillean cuotas anteriores cuando la propia evidencia y la secuencia contractual permiten concluir continuidad de pagos con alta confianza.

evidenceRules.evidence: Usuario autorizado confirma expresamente pago de una cuota desde Cliente 360 o Cobros y cartera
evidenceRules.directEffect: Se materializa/reconcilia el cobro de la cuota seleccionada con fecha/método/evidencia disponible.
evidenceRules.inferredEffect: No se infieren cuotas anteriores únicamente por una confirmación manual aislada, salvo que el usuario seleccione explícitamente la opción de conciliar la secuencia anterior o adjunte evidencia que active otra regla.

requiredConditions: Existe una única póliza/cliente/recibo compatible con la evidencia.
La moneda y el contexto contractual son compatibles.
La numeración/periodicidad de cuotas permite inferir una secuencia contigua.
No existe evidencia contradictoria de impago, reversión, anulación, pago parcial, refinanciación, cambio de plan o endoso que rompa la secuencia.
La misma evidencia no fue aplicada previamente.
El cobro/conciliación se ejecuta idempotentemente en un comando server-owned.
failClosedCases: Secuencia de cuotas no contigua o renumerada.
Pago parcial o distribución entre varias obligaciones.
Cobro previamente conciliado con otra evidencia incompatible.
autoCommitPolicy.failClosedAction: Crear propuesta de conciliación para revisión humana; no autoescribir cobro.

clientReportedPayment.effect: Materialize payment for the matched receipt and remove that obligation from pending/overdue portfolio, while application/insurer reconciliation may remain pending.
clientReportedPayment.originRequirement: Must have explicit CLIENT_PORTAL / client_reported provenance. estadoOperativo=pago_reportado alone is insufficient.

actualPaidDate.meaning: Fecha real en que el cliente efectuó el pago.
actualPaidDate.source: Payment support, explicit client/user-provided date, or other direct evidence.

inferredPeriodDate.meaning: Fecha/período operativo usado para atribuir una cuota cerrada por inferencia cuando paidDate real es desconocida.
inferredPeriodDate.rule: Use the expected receipt due date / scheduled installment date for that inferred installment.
inferredPeriodDate.purpose: Do not inflate the month in which the inference process ran; historical inferred installments remain attributed to the month in which that installment was contractually due.

evidenceAsOfDate.meaning: Fecha/as-of del estado de cuenta, planilla u otra evidencia que permitió la inferencia.

applicationDate.meaning: Fecha en que el pago fue aplicado por la aseguradora.
sourcePriority: Insurer invoice date when the invoice proves application

reconciledAt.meaning: Timestamp técnico en que Gravicentra ejecutó la conciliación/inferencia.

paymentSupport.intelligentPrefill: When an uploaded support yields a unique readable payment date, prefill paidDate; keep user-editable before commit.

insurerInvoice.intelligentPrefill: When an uploaded invoice yields a unique invoice number/date, prefill invoiceNumber and applicationDate; keep user-editable before commit.
insurerInvoice.semanticRule: Invoice date is applicationDate, not actualPaidDate, unless the same document explicitly and unambiguously proves both.

rules: Commission statement paying installment N: N is direct paid/application evidence and open contiguous 1..N-1 are auto-closed by inference unless contradicted.
Insurer statement showing pending from installment N: 1..N-1 are auto-closed by inference; N and later remain pending unless later evidence proves otherwise.
Insurer invoice for installment N: N is direct application evidence and open contiguous 1..N-1 may auto-close by inference unless contradicted.
installmentSequence.explicitTotalInstallmentsAuthority: When an authoritative insurer statement/account statement exposes N/M or otherwise states the policy total installment count M, M is authoritative for reconciliation of the expected-receipt schedule.
installmentSequence.scheduleMismatchAction: If platform expected-receipt count differs from an explicit authoritative total, do not silently retain the wrong calendar; reconcile the schedule through controlled idempotent receipt-plan correction with provenance. Contradictory sources remain review-required.

insurerPaymentPlanConfig.validationRule: A 12-installment fraccionado schedule for these insurers is invalid under current approved tenant configuration and must be corrected or blocked; any future exception requires explicit authoritative policy evidence plus an approved insurer-config change.

stateModel.reconciliationRule: Payment may be valid before insurer application is known. Payment support and invoice/application reconciliation are independent enrichments.

commissionLinkage.rule: Commission eligibility/timing is driven by application evidence/applicationDate or commission-statement evidence, not by paidDate alone.
commissionLinkage.advisorConfiguration: Use the advisor commission model/percentage configured in Equipo/Usuarios. Operational calculation must not silently substitute demo/default percentages when required configuration is missing.
commissionLinkage.missingConfiguration: Fail closed as REQUIERE_CONFIGURACION; do not fabricate commission values.
commissionLinkage.materialization: I6.7 must materialize/reconcile company commission and advisor commission against policy/receipt/payment/application evidence and the configured advisor model.

originPresentation.migratedCrm: Pago registrado en SIGA · pendiente de conciliación

antiDuplication: One canonical payment/reconciliation command is used by every surface.
Direct evidence on installment N and inferred closure of prior installments must be committed atomically when possible.
Later evidence for an already inferred installment enriches provenance instead of creating a second cobro.
Retries and double-submits must return the prior committed result through idempotency.

currentTenantClarification.migratedPaymentSourceSemantics: Existing migrated payment evidence from SIGA CRM must be treated as historical direct payment evidence, not as client portal reports.
sourceAuthorityEvidence: I6_5_RECIBOS_CARTERA_SOURCE_INTAKE_20260918: CobranzaCendoso (24) actual payment date is primary direct payment evidence.
